subject: The Line Up
author: ZombieTron
body:
Hit start to get into the game menu, the line up is one of the many options available.

According to the manual 30 pics of each type can be held in the line up. You need 50 in total to get the achievement. So, you need to do races online as well as getting take-downs to get enough pics.

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: yo we both got a cam, but

body: yo we both got a cam, but what do you mean by you need 50 pics in your line up?

subject: Hot Shots
author: ZombieTron
body:
You need to have 50 pics in your line up. Does your friend have a cam plugged in?

When you take him down you will receive a pic, but you also need to get pics from races etc to get a full 50.
